PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.s_intro_body: Lumiris is an electronic health record for occupational therapists. This policy explains how we handle personal data — yours, as a professional, and your patients', recorded by you on the platform.
PrivacyPage.s_roles_body: Regarding your patients' data, you are the controller: you decide what to record and for what purpose. Lumiris acts as the processor, handling that data on your behalf and following your instructions. Regarding your account and billing data, Lumiris is the controller.
PrivacyPage.s_data_body: From your account: name, email, CREFITO number and subscription data. From your patients, as you record it: identification, guardian contact, clinical history, intake, progress notes, treatment plan, reports and attachments. Some of this is considered sensitive health data under the LGPD.
PrivacyPage.s_purpose_body: To operate the chart: store and organize records, generate PDF documents, structure notes and reports with AI assistance and process your subscription. We do not use your patients' data for advertising, nor do we sell it.
PrivacyPage.s_basis_body: Processing of your account data relies on performance of the contract. Processing of patients' health data is done by you, the controller, under the appropriate legal basis — typically health care provision or the consent of the patient or guardian. Ensuring this basis is your responsibility.
PrivacyPage.s_ai_body: Session audio and text may be sent to an AI provider for transcription and structuring. Generated content is always a draft, reviewed by you before saving. Clinical responsibility stays with the therapist.
PrivacyPage.s_sharing_body: We share data only with providers essential to operation — authentication, hosting, payment processing and AI — under confidentiality and security obligations. We do not share with third parties for other purposes.
PrivacyPage.s_retention_body: We keep records while your account is active. After cancellation you can export everything; afterwards, data is deleted respecting the legal record-retention periods applicable to the profession.
PrivacyPage.s_security_body: Data travels encrypted (TLS) and is encrypted at rest. Access is restricted to your account. We apply technical and organizational measures to protect the information.
PrivacyPage.s_rights_body: Data subjects may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, portability and deletion of data, among other LGPD rights. Patient requests should be directed to you, the controller; we assist as needed.
PrivacyPage.s_contact_body: For privacy questions or to exercise rights regarding data under our responsibility, reach us at privacidade@lumiris.com.br.
PrivacyPage.s_changes_body: We may update this policy. We will communicate relevant changes, and the update date will always appear at the top.

TermsPage.title: Terms of Use
TermsPage.s_intro_body: By creating an account and using Lumiris, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
TermsPage.s_service_body: Lumiris is an electronic health record for occupational therapists, with intake, treatment plan, progress notes, reports and PDF export, including AI features to assist with writing.
TermsPage.s_eligibility_body: You must be a licensed professional or an occupational therapy student and provide truthful information. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential.
TermsPage.s_responsibility_body: You are clinically and legally responsible for the records you create. You must ensure the legal basis to process your patients' health data and the accuracy of the information entered.
TermsPage.s_ai_body: AI generates drafts from your audio or text. Suggestions may contain errors and must be reviewed and validated by you before saving. Lumiris does not replace your clinical judgment.
TermsPage.s_payment_body: There is a free plan and paid plans. Paid subscriptions are charged via Pix, recurrently, and can be cancelled anytime, with no lock-in. Features vary by plan.
TermsPage.s_ip_body: Lumiris's software, brand and content are ours. The data you record remains yours; you grant us only what is needed to operate the service.
TermsPage.s_availability_body: We aim to keep the service available, but it is provided as is, without warranty of uninterrupted operation. We may perform maintenance and improvements.
TermsPage.s_liability_body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages. Clinical responsibility for care and records always lies with the professional.
TermsPage.s_termination_body: You can close your account anytime and export your data beforehand. We may suspend accounts that violate these Terms.
TermsPage.s_law_body: These Terms are governed by Brazilian law. Any disputes will be handled in the courts of your domicile, where applicable.
TermsPage.s_changes_body: We may update these Terms. Relevant changes will be communicated, and the update date will appear at the top.

LgpdPage.title: LGPD and data protection
LgpdPage.s_intro_body: Lumiris was designed to handle personal data responsibly, in compliance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law 13.709/2018).
LgpdPage.s_roles_body: You, the therapist, are the controller of your patients' data. Lumiris is the processor, handling that data on your behalf. This defines who answers for each decision about the data.
LgpdPage.s_sensitive_body: Health records contain sensitive data. It receives reinforced protection: restricted access, encryption and a purpose limited to therapeutic care.
LgpdPage.s_rights_body: The LGPD grants the patient, among others, the rights of access, correction, anonymization, portability, information about sharing and deletion of data.
LgpdPage.s_exercise_body: Since the data is managed by the therapist, patients should contact the responsible professional. For data under Lumiris's responsibility, or for support, write to privacidade@lumiris.com.br.
LgpdPage.s_security_body: We use essential providers — authentication, hosting, payment and AI — with confidentiality and security commitments. Data travels and is stored encrypted.
LgpdPage.s_contact_body: Data protection questions can be sent to our data protection officer at privacidade@lumiris.com.br.

Landing.meta_title: Lumiris — The chart that grows with you
Landing.meta_description: The smart chart for occupational therapists. Structured intake, voice-based session notes powered by AI, and quarterly reports in minutes.
Landing.hero_subtitle: Structured intake, voice-based session notes and quarterly reports in minutes — without losing clinical rigor.
Landing.problem_title: Documenting is part of care. Losing hours on it isn't.
Landing.problem_a_body: Insurance asks every three months. You gather notes scattered across notebooks, Word, WhatsApp, and rebuild it all in Word again.
Landing.problem_b_body: End of the day: ten pending session notes. You forget details that matter. Record quality drops.
Landing.problem_c_body: Every new patient, a blank Word document. You copy from the last one, tweak, print.
Landing.solution_title: Three flows. Designed to be used every day.
Landing.solution_a_body: CREFITO-aligned template covering identification, clinical history, habits, development, family background and initial assessment — all in one place, exportable to PDF.
Landing.solution_b_body: You speak, Lumiris transcribes and organizes the note automatically — procedure, incident and health status progress. From 10 minutes to 2.
Landing.solution_c_body: Lumiris reads every note in the period, cross-references the treatment objectives, and returns a report ready for insurance.
Landing.preview_title: Everything in one place. No more Word, WhatsApp and notebook.
Landing.preview_subtitle: The dashboard you open every morning. Patients, upcoming sessions, report alerts — exactly where they should be.
Landing.how_title: From new patient to report, in one journey.
Landing.how_step_a_body: Personal data, diagnosis, ICD, school, professionals involved. All in a form designed for OTs.
Landing.how_step_b_title: Record notes at the speed of the session
Landing.how_step_b_body: Record audio at the end of the session, Lumiris organizes the note into sections, you review and save. Done.
Landing.how_step_c_title: Generate the report when you need it
Landing.how_step_c_body: Pick the period, Lumiris cross-references notes and objectives, returns a formatted PDF. You review, adjust, send.
Landing.features_title: Everything an OT needs. Nothing they don't.
Landing.features_a_body: Intake, treatment plan, notes and reports — linked to the patient.
Landing.features_b_body: Templates formatted for CREFITO and common insurance providers.
Landing.features_c_body: LGPD compliance. Encrypted data. Yours alone.
Landing.features_d_body: See the week's sessions and link notes to appointments.
Landing.features_e_body: Reminds you when the quarterly report is due — before insurance asks.
Landing.features_f_body: Not a generic medical app. Built with therapists, for therapists.
Landing.compare_subtitle: Compare what you do today with what Lumiris delivers.
Landing.compare_row_a_old: 30-45 min on a blank Word doc
Landing.compare_row_b_lume: 1-2 min: you speak, Lumiris organizes the note
Landing.pricing_subtitle: From OT students in placement to therapists with a packed schedule — there's a Lumiris for each stage.
Landing.pricing_free_tagline: To try Lumiris with real patients, no rush.
Landing.pricing_student_tagline: For OT students in supervised placement who want pro tools from day one.
Landing.pricing_pro_tagline: For OTs in clinic, school or home visits — who need it all to just work.
Landing.pricing_pro_feature_4: Templates for CREFITO + Unimed + Bradesco + SulAmérica
Landing.pricing_clinic_line: Run a clinic or multidisciplinary team? <link>Talk to us</link> about the Clinic plan.
Landing.trust_title: Your patient trusts you. You can trust Lumiris.
Landing.trust_subtitle: The data you keep is confidential. We treat each piece the way you would.
Landing.trust_a_body: We collect only what's needed, with clear legal basis and full patient rights respected.
Landing.trust_b_body: Encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest. Only you access your patients.
Landing.trust_c_body: Infrastructure on national servers. No unnecessary cross-border transit.
Landing.trust_d_body: Export everything as PDF or JSON, anytime. No lock-in, no hostages.
Landing.founder_quote: I watched my partner burn nights putting together reports in Word. Watched spreadsheets crash, intakes vanish in downloads folders. Lumiris was born from that — to give time back to people who care for people.
Landing.faq_title: What OTs ask before signing up.
Landing.faq_a_a: Yes. Digital health records are legally valid in Brazil since Law 13.787/2018. Lumiris generates electronically signed records that you can export as PDF.
Landing.faq_b_q: Does the AI write the note for me?
Landing.faq_b_a: The AI drafts a structure from your audio or text. You always review and adjust before saving. Clinical responsibility stays yours.
Landing.faq_c_q: Does it work for other professions besides OT?
Landing.faq_c_a: The MVP focuses on OT because that's where we know the pain best. Soon: speech, psychology, physiotherapy.
Landing.faq_d_q: Do I need internet all the time?
Landing.faq_d_a: Yes. Lumiris is web-based. But the interface is light and works well on 4G.
Landing.faq_e_a: Yes. No fines, no lock-in. You keep access to your exported PDFs.
Landing.faq_f_q: What about my patients' data if I cancel?
Landing.faq_f_a: You can export everything as PDF/JSON beforehand. After cancellation, we follow LGPD: data deletion after the legal retention period.
Landing.cta_title: Your next session ends with no pending notes.
Landing.cta_subtitle: Create your free account and watch time come back to you.
Landing.footer_made_for: Built for people who care for people.
